0022600009.text: The Rockets (1-0, first in the Southwest and third in the West) visit the Spurs (0-1, fourth in the Southwest and 10th in the West) in the second game of Houston's season. Last season the Rockets lost the series 1-3, most recently a 145-120 defeat in San Antonio on March 8, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season. Steven Adams is day-to-day with calf soreness and is a game-time decision for Houston, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out after knee surgery) and Tobias Harris, who is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision.
